meta.name: alfworld-search-verifier
meta.description: Re-examines previously visited locations to confirm the absence of a target object or to check for overlooked items. Use when an initial search fails to find enough objects or when double-checking is required before concluding task failure. Systematically revisits receptacles, re-opens closed containers, and re-inspects contents to ensure no viable location was missed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新检查已探索区域，确认目标物品是否遗漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在搜索任务中需要确保没有遗漏任何可能的位置
copy.tagline_en: Re-examine visited areas to confirm no target object was missed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure no location was overlooked during a search task

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会重新检查之前搜过的容器和位置，打开已关闭的容器，仔细查看是否有遗漏的目标物品，然后告诉你找到或没找到。
howto.when: 当你第一次搜索没找够目标物品，或者需要确认所有可能位置都已查过、没有遗漏时触发。

say.text: 再检查一遍刚才的抽屉，看看有没有漏掉手机。
say.note: 触发重新搜索特定容器

say.text: 确认所有容器都查过了，确保没有遗漏钥匙。
第二次搜桌子，看看有没有之前忽略的物品。

howto.what_en: Claude will re-check previously visited containers and locations, open closed ones, and carefully inspect for overlooked target objects, then report found or not.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an initial search fails to find enough target objects, or when double-checking is needed to ensure no location was missed.

say_en.text: Re-check the drawer you just searched for a missed cellphone.
say_en.note: Trigger re-search of a specific container

say_en.text: Verify all containers are checked, ensure no key is missed.
Search the table again for any overlooked items.
